```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

file <- "Pricing Modeling Gary.xlsx"
if (!file.exists(file)) stop("Keep Pricing Modeling Gary.xlsx in the same folder as this Rmd.")
base <- read_excel(file, range = "D2:F4", col_names = FALSE)
segment <- read_excel(file, range = "H8:I12", col_names = FALSE)
borrower <- read_excel(file, range = "K9:L11", col_names = FALSE)
structure <- read_excel(file, range = "N8:O11", col_names = FALSE)
make_map <- function(labels, values) {
  stats::setNames(as.list(as.numeric(values)), trimws(as.character(labels)))
}
model <- list(
  base = make_map(base[[1]], as.numeric(base[[2]]) + as.numeric(base[[3]])),
  segment = make_map(segment[[1]], segment[[2]]),
  borrower = make_map(borrower[[1]], borrower[[2]]),
  structure = make_map(structure[[1]], structure[[2]])
)
selected <- list(
  base = as.character(read_excel(file, range = "D16", col_names = FALSE)[[1]][1]),
  segment = as.character(read_excel(file, range = "D19", col_names = FALSE)[[1]][1]),
  borrower = as.character(read_excel(file, range = "D20", col_names = FALSE)[[1]][1]),
  structure = as.character(read_excel(file, range = "D21", col_names = FALSE)[[1]][1])
)
model_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(model, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 12)
defaults_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(selected, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r embedded-data, results='asis'}
cat('<script type="application/json" id="pricing-model">', model_json, '</script>\n', sep = '')
cat('<script type="application/json" id="pricing-defaults">', defaults_json, '</script>\n', sep = '')
```

<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
  const model = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pricing-model').textContent);
  const defaults = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pricing-defaults').textContent);
  const keys = ['base','segment','borrower','structure'];
  const selects = {};
  keys.forEach(k => {
    const el = document.getElementById(k+'-select'); selects[k]=el;
    Object.keys(model[k]).forEach(name => {
      const opt=document.createElement('option'); opt.value=name;opt.textContent=name;el.appendChild(opt);
    });
    el.value=defaults[k].trim();
    if(el.selectedIndex<0) el.selectedIndex=0;
    el.addEventListener('change',update);
  });
  const gd=document.querySelector('.plot-area .js-plotly-plot');
  if(!gd || !window.Plotly){document.getElementById('yield-value').textContent='Plot unavailable';return;}
  const coords={segment:Object.keys(model.segment),borrower:Object.keys(model.borrower),structure:Object.keys(model.structure)};
  const pct=n=>(100*n).toFixed(2)+'%';
  const signed=n=>(n>=0?'+':'')+(100*n).toFixed(2)+'%';
  function line(a,b,color='#D3D3D3',width=2){return {type:'scatter3d',mode:'lines',x:[a[0],b[0]],y:[a[1],b[1]],z:[a[2],b[2]],line:{color,width},hoverinfo:'skip',showlegend:false};}
  function mesh(vertices,color,opacity){
    return {type:'mesh3d',x:vertices.map(p=>p[0]),y:vertices.map(p=>p[1]),z:vertices.map(p=>p[2]),
      i:[0,0],j:[1,2],k:[2,3],color,opacity,flatshading:true,hoverinfo:'skip',showlegend:false};
  }
  function plane(axis,v,color){
    if(axis==='x')return mesh([[v,.5,.5],[v,5.5,.5],[v,5.5,4.5],[v,.5,4.5]],color,.22);
    if(axis==='y')return mesh([[.5,v,.5],[3.5,v,.5],[3.5,v,4.5],[.5,v,4.5]],color,.22);
    return mesh([[.5,.5,v],[3.5,.5,v],[3.5,5.5,v],[.5,5.5,v]],color,.22);
  }
  function cube(x,y,z){
    const a=x-.47,b=x+.47,c=y-.47,d=y+.47,e=z-.47,f=z+.47;
    return {type:'mesh3d',x:[a,b,b,a,a,b,b,a],y:[c,c,d,d,c,c,d,d],z:[e,e,e,e,f,f,f,f],
      i:[0,0,0,1,1,2,3,4,4,5,6,7],j:[1,2,4,2,5,3,7,5,6,6,7,4],k:[2,3,5,5,6,7,4,6,7,2,3,0],
      color:'#ff841e',opacity:.55,flatshading:true,hoverinfo:'skip',showlegend:false};
  }
  function update(){
    const chosen=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,selects[k].value]));
    const x=coords.borrower.indexOf(chosen.borrower)+1;
    const y=coords.segment.indexOf(chosen.segment)+1;
    const z=coords.structure.indexOf(chosen.structure)+1;
    const yieldValue=model.base[chosen.base]+model.segment[chosen.segment]+model.borrower[chosen.borrower]+model.structure[chosen.structure];
    const minimumYield=yieldValue-0.005; // 0.50 percentage points, e.g. 8.25% -> 7.75%
    document.getElementById('yield-value').textContent=pct(yieldValue);
    document.getElementById('minimum-value').textContent=pct(minimumYield);
    document.getElementById('yield-breakdown').innerHTML=
      'Base: '+pct(model.base[chosen.base])+'<br>Segment: '+signed(model.segment[chosen.segment])+ '<br>Borrower: '+signed(model.borrower[chosen.borrower])+'<br>Structure: '+signed(model.structure[chosen.structure]);
    const traces=[];
    // Three-axis wireframe: X=Borrower/Pricing Level, Y=Segment Risk, Z=Structure Risk.
    for(let xi=.5;xi<=3.5;xi++)for(let yi of [.5,5.5])traces.push(line([xi,yi,.5],[xi,yi,4.5]));
    for(let xi=.5;xi<=3.5;xi++)for(let zi of [.5,4.5])traces.push(line([xi,.5,zi],[xi,5.5,zi]));
    for(let yi=.5;yi<=5.5;yi++)for(let xi of [.5,3.5])traces.push(line([xi,yi,.5],[xi,yi,4.5]));
    for(let yi=.5;yi<=5.5;yi++)for(let zi of [.5,4.5])traces.push(line([.5,yi,zi],[3.5,yi,zi]));
    for(let zi=.5;zi<=4.5;zi++)for(let xi of [.5,3.5])traces.push(line([xi,.5,zi],[xi,5.5,zi]));
    for(let zi=.5;zi<=4.5;zi++)for(let yi of [.5,5.5])traces.push(line([.5,yi,zi],[3.5,yi,zi]));
    traces.push(plane('x',x,'#eea05c'),plane('y',y,'#4b9bd1'),plane('z',z,'#62b77a'),cube(x,y,z));
    // Both markers lie on the vertical pricing-level plane (constant X).
    // Separate them vertically along Segment Risk for readability; this is a
    // visual offset only, not a change in risk category or a yield axis.
    traces.push({type:'scatter3d',mode:'markers+text',x:[x],y:[y+.16],z:[z],
      marker:{size:8,color:'#277b32',line:{color:'#102b18',width:2}},
      text:['Target: '+pct(yieldValue)],textposition:'top left',
      textfont:{size:13,color:'#176a2a'},
      hovertext:[chosen.segment+' / '+chosen.borrower+' / '+chosen.structure+'<br>Risk Adjusted Yield: '+pct(yieldValue)],
      hoverinfo:'text',name:'Risk Adjusted Yield',showlegend:false});
    traces.push({type:'scatter3d',mode:'markers+text',x:[x],y:[y-.16],z:[z],
      marker:{size:8,color:'#d62828',line:{color:'#7f1414',width:2}},
      text:['Minimum: '+pct(minimumYield)],textposition:'bottom right',
      textfont:{size:13,color:'#b91c1c'},
      hovertext:[chosen.segment+' / '+chosen.borrower+' / '+chosen.structure+'<br>Minimum Yield: '+pct(minimumYield)],
      hoverinfo:'text',name:'Minimum Yield',showlegend:false});
    const layout={margin:{l:0,r:0,b:0,t:0},paper_bgcolor:'#fff',showlegend:false,uirevision:'keep-camera',
      scene:{aspectmode:'manual',aspectratio:{x:1.35,y:1,z:1.05},
  xaxis:{title:{text:'<b>Pricing Level</b>',font:{size:14,color:'#000000'}},range:[.4,3.6],tickvals:[1,2,3],ticktext:coords.borrower,zeroline:false},
  yaxis:{title:{text:'<b>LGD / Structure Risk</b>',font:{size:14,color:'#000000'}},range:[.4,4.6],tickvals:[1,2,3,4],ticktext:coords.structure,zeroline:false},
  zaxis:{title:{text:'<b>Segment Risk</b>',font:{size:14,color:'#000000'}},range:[.4,5.6],tickvals:[1,2,3,4,5],ticktext:coords.segment,zeroline:false}
}};
    // Plotly uses Z as the vertical screen axis. Swap the model's Y and Z
    // coordinates for display, keeping the Segment risk vertical.
    traces.forEach(t => {const temp=t.y; t.y=t.z; t.z=temp;});
    layout.scene.camera={eye:{x:1.65,y:-1.75,z:1.15},up:{x:0,y:0,z:1}};
    Plotly.react(gd,traces,layout,{responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
  }
  update();
});
</script>
